title: Who is holding what
intro: Who holds documents waiting for a decision, how many, how long they have waited in business hours, and which are past their due time (SLA). People with documents past due come first.
forbidden: This account cannot open the board because it is not an active member of the organization. Contact your organization admin.

scope.ORG: Showing pending documents across the organization
scope.DEPT: Showing the requests charged to the departments you head, your tasks and the documents you requested
scope.OWN: Showing your tasks and the documents you requested

asOf: Counted up to {time} · ages count business hours only

empty.title: No pending documents within your scope
empty.hint: When a document waits for someone's decision it shows here with how long it has waited. Meanwhile, see what waits for you on the approvals page.
empty.filteredTitle: No pending documents match these filters
empty.filteredHint: Choose another department or kind of document, or clear the filters to see everything.

table.title: {count, plural, one {# person holds pending documents} other {# people hold pending documents}}
table.hint: Press a name or a figure to see that person's documents and send a reminder.
table.caption: Pending documents by holder
table.waitingLink: {count} awaiting the requester at {name}: see documents
table.oldestLink: Oldest {hours} business hours at {name}: see documents
table.averageLink: Average {hours} business hours at {name}: see documents

remind.recent: Reminded within the hour; it can be sent again after {time}
remind.sent: Reminder sent at {time} · this document can be reminded again after {again}
remind.rule: A document can be reminded by hand once an hour, whoever sends it. Documents waiting for the requester's answer do not need the approver reminded yet.
remind.readOnly: Documents without a reminder button are ones you see as the auditor, who only reads and cannot send reminders.

errors.RECENT: The reminder was not sent: someone reminded this document within the last hour. It can be sent again after {time}.
errors.BUSY: The system is busy with other work, so the reminder was not sent. Wait a moment and press remind again.
errors.STATE: The reminder was not sent: this document no longer waits for a decision (it was decided or waits for the requester). Press See the latest figures to update the list.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This task is no longer within your scope; it may have been decided or moved. Press See the latest figures to update the list.
errors.READ_ONLY: The reminder was not sent: you see this document as the auditor, who only reads.
errors.FORBIDDEN: The reminder was not sent: this account may no longer remind about this document. If it should, ask your organization admin to check its roles.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and retry.
errors.CONFLICT: This press clashed with another command. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong and the reminder was not sent. Try again; if it still fails, tell your admin the reference {requestId}.
errors.FAILED: The reminder was not sent. Check your connection and try again.

person.noneTitle: This person holds no pending documents within your scope
person.noneHint: The documents may have been decided, or fall outside the filters you chose. Go back to the board for the overview.
person.title: Documents held by {name}
person.summary: Awaiting decision {open} · past due {overdue} · awaiting requester {waiting}
person.ages: Oldest {oldest} business hours · average {average} business hours
